# Stepper

> The wizard's step list: lettered markers, states, and optional navigation back to finished steps.

Category: Navigation. Docs page: https://rime.mjsons.net/components/stepper

## Installation

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add KezLahd/rime/stepper
```

Stepper heads a multi-step form. Steps are complete, current, upcoming or error; onStepClick lets people return to a finished step.

## Usage

```tsx
import { Stepper } from "@/components/ui";

<Stepper aria-label="Checkout" steps={steps} onStepClick={goTo} />
```

## Props: Stepper

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` (required) | `ReadonlyArray<StepperStep>` |  |  |
| `onStepClick` | `(id: string) => void` |  | Makes complete, error and current steps clickable. Upcoming steps never are. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Examples

## Accessibility

- The current step carries aria-current="step".

## Do

- Let people go back to any finished step.

## Don't

- Don't let people jump ahead past an unfinished step.
